sources.entry: cassandra-driver - The Python driver for Apache Cassandra.

summary.one_liner: The official Python client driver for Apache Cassandra and DataStax Enterprise, speaking Cassandra's binary protocol and CQL v3.
summary.what_it_does: The driver connects Python applications to Apache Cassandra (2.1+) and DataStax Enterprise (4.7+) over the binary protocol using CQL v3. It offers both synchronous and asynchronous APIs, along with simple, prepared, and batch statements. It includes connection pooling, automatic node discovery and reconnection, and configurable load balancing and retry policies. It also bundles cqlengine, an object mapper, and supports connecting to DataStax Astra cloud databases. The README additionally lists DSE Graph execution, DSE geometric type serialization, and DSE PlainText and GSSAPI authentication.
use_cases: connect Python app to DataStax Enterprise
connect to DataStax Astra cloud database
map Cassandra tables to Python objects
run prepared or batch CQL statements
notable: Sync and async APIs with request pipelining
Includes cqlengine object mapper maintained in the package
DSE Graph and DSE authentication support
caveats: DataStax products do not support big-endian systems
Bug reports go through the ASF JIRA project rather than GitHub issues
